text:
Asha: Heads-up — Skyline Health renewal next Tue (10am PT). We need to align on SLO acceptance: uptime %, p95/p99 latency baselines, and any potential credit exposure. Can we assemble evidence + a short remediation plan if we missed targets?
Jamal: I'll pull the SLO report now. @Priya can you confirm if the p99 change last month was tied to the model rollout/quantization patch?
Priya: Yes — we rolled a small quantization change on redwood-legacy-v2 on Mar 3. That bumped p99 by ~120ms for certain chat routes. Tail is mostly isolated to session-based chat (route: /v1/chat/session).
Elliot: I saw a spike on the evening of Mar 15 as well — logs show CPU pressure on ded01 during the window. Re-running the traces to confirm correlation.
sla-bot: Uptime for Skyline Health (last 30d): 99.92% (SLO: 99.95%). Flag: potential credit exposure detected.
Jamal: Ok that's a gap. Asha, do we want to propose a pro-rated credit or a remediation-only offer? Sales will likely ask for both.
Asha: Let's prepare both. Draft packet should include: 1) Evidence (uptime calc + traces), 2) Root cause (quantization + CPU pressure), 3) Remediation plan (config patch + routing fallback), 4) Proposed credit calc. Who takes each piece?
Priya: I'll own root cause + remediation steps. ETA: EOD today for a short write-up I can add to the packet.
Elliot: I'll attach the trace snippets and an incident timeline. Need the customer-facing report template — @Jamal can you share the template link?
Jamal: Yep — using 'SLO-customer-packet-v2'. Link: https://redwood.app/slo-templates/slo-customer-packet-v2. I'll attach the latency graphs and the CSV export.
Asha: Also capture mitigation options: temporary routing to a dedicated pool if p99 > 1200ms during peak, and an autoscaling knob tweak.
Priya: On it. Quick query I used for p99 by route:
```sql
SELECT route, percentile(latency, 0.99) AS p99, count(*)
FROM requests
WHERE customer_id='skyline' AND timestamp >= '2026-02-01'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY p99 DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Elliot: I'll schedule a 30m sync for tomorrow 09:30 PT to run through packet + owners. Calendar invite coming. :calendar:
Asha: Owners: Priya (root cause + remediation), Elliot (traces + timeline), Jamal (comms + credit calc), Asha (customer runbook & signoff). Deliverable: consolidated packet by EOD tomorrow for pre-read.
Jamal: For credit calc — baseline approach: prorate lost uptime from 99.95% down to observed (99.92%) across billing period and multiply by monthly invoice. If we see sustained p99 tail impacting requests, model a secondary option: 5% service credit for the affected month. I'll attach a spreadsheet with both scenarios.
Priya: One ask for the packet — include a 3-bullet "what we changed" section for non-technical readers. I'll draft it terse.
Asha: Also include acceptance criteria and checkpoints: propose 7/14/30 day checkpoints with measurable targets (p99 <= baseline + 50ms). If SLA fix not met by 30 days, include defined credit path.
Jamal: I'll also add a canned comms paragraph for Legal & Sales to reuse. fyi @legal-team
Elliot: deploy-bot: deploy/redwood/inference-service @Priya completed at 4298765490 :white_check_mark:
Asha: Thanks — this looks good. I'll assemble the packet skeleton and circulate for review before we send to Skyline. :raised_hands:
